name: koala-compat-layer-removal
title: Delete the legacy-koala backward-compat and migration layer from product code (ship-clean story 2)
description: koala rebranding is already DONE (the verify-koala-residue gate passes with zero unclassified residue); what remains is a deliberately-retained legacy-koala backward-compat and migration layer. Per the no-compat directive, story 2 deletes that layer from product runtime code: the legacy activity-log reader, the KOALA_ env-var fallbacks, the legacy-koala write-path detection, and the old-koala-artifact cleanup.
